title: Very thin glass and lid is loose.
text: Very thin glass and lid is loose.. I dont think this is air tight because the lid comes off pretty easy, even with the rubber seal. It came very well packed. It is lightweight and honestly, for glass I think this is very thin. You certainly cant pick it up by the lid. Not sure now how I will use it. Shame its so thin.
